fullDescription: A high-end, minimalist dark-mode design system for elite engineering studios, fintech, and boutique software agencies. Characterized by a deep #000000 background, vibrant #c7ff9f lime green accents, and a sophisticated pairing of sharp sans-serif and italic serif typography. Features include zero-radius sharp corners, premium whitespace, glassmorphism headers, and high-contrast section transitions. Suitable for technical brands requiring an aura of precision, performance, and institutional authority.

structured.summary: ProdFlow Elite Engineering Style: A precision-engineered digital aesthetic using a monochromatic dark base with neon-lime accents. It utilizes Instrument Sans for technical clarity and Instrument Serif (Italic) for editorial elegance, emphasizing a 'no-border-radius' philosophy to communicate sharpness and technical rigour.

style.description: Minimalist Dark Editorial style. Colors: Primary Black (#000000), Accent Lime (#c7ff9f), Secondary Charcoal (#1a1a1a), and pure White (#ffffff). Typography: Instrument Sans for UI and Instrument Serif for headlines. Animations: Smooth cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) transitions. UI is defined by sharp edges (0px border-radius) and high-contrast 'inverted' sections (switching from dark to light).
style.prompt: Create a design with a pure black (#000000) background and white text. Use a vibrant lime green (#c7ff9f) as the primary accent for buttons, icons, and specific keyword highlights. Typography: Use 'Instrument Sans' (400, 500, 700) for body and navigation with 0.15em tracking, and 'Instrument Serif' (Italic) for large display headlines (80px to 120px). Design Constraint: Strictly zero border-radius on all elements (buttons, cards, inputs). Spacing: High padding (sections 160px+ vertical), wide gutters. Interaction: Use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all hover states. Shadows: None; use thin 1px borders (#ffffff/10) for depth.

layout_and_structure.description: A structured, section-based landing page layout with a fixed glassmorphism header, wide hero area, utility-focused feature grid, and high-contrast alternating case studies, ending with a striking light-mode contact section.

prompts.partPt: Menu do Topo Menu do Topo
prompts.prompt: Fixed 96px height header. Background: black at 80% opacity with backdrop-blur-md. 1px bottom border in white/5. Layout: Left-aligned logo (uppercase bold, accompanied by a vertical lime green 6px bar); Centered nav links in 12px uppercase bold sans-serif with 0.15em tracking; Right-aligned 'Inquire Now' CTA. The CTA must be an outlined button that fills with lime green from bottom-to-top on hover.

Full-height (min-h-screen) section. Features a split background with a subtle vertical charcoal strip (#1a1a1a) on the right 30%. Main content: A lime green 'Location' tag in 14px bold uppercase; Headline: 120px italic serif 'We engineer products that [accent]dominate[/accent]' with the accent word in lime green. Two sharp-edged 200px wide buttons: Primary (Solid White), Secondary (Outlined White/20).

3-column grid layout with 1px gap to simulate internal borders. Each card is #0a0a0a background with 48px padding. Elements: 48px lime green iconify-icon; 30px bold sans-serif title; 18px muted white/40 body text. Interaction: On hover, a 4px lime green bar animates from 0% to 100% width at the card bottom.

Alternating grid (Image-Text / Text-Image). Image container: 600px height, charcoal background (#1a1a1a) with a subtle lime-to-transparent gradient overlay. Text container: Features a large 60px italic serif title; two-column metric grid below (e.g., '99.9%' in lime serif); and an arrow-link 'View Case Study' with horizontal movement on hover.

High-contrast break. Full section switch to #ffffff background and #000000 text. Left side: 120px italic serif headline. Right side: Minimalist form with thin 1px black/10 bottom borders only for inputs (no boxes). Input labels are 12px uppercase bold. Submit button: Large black block that turns lime green on hover.

special_ui_components.description: A typographic logo with an animated status indicator.
special_ui_components.prompt: A text-based logo 'PRODFLOW' in 24px bold tracking-tighter uppercase. Next to it, a 6px wide, 24px high vertical rectangle in #c7ff9f. On hover of the parent container, the bar scales 1.25x vertically using a smooth spring transition.

special_ui_components.description: Sharp card that emphasizes technical performance data.
special_ui_components.prompt: A 1px bordered charcoal box. Top half contains a 50px italic serif number in lime green. Bottom half contains 10px bold uppercase metadata. On hover, the border-color changes to lime green and the background brightness increases by 5%.
